title: Optimal transport map estimation in general function spaces
tldr_zh: 半对偶 ERM 推广到任意势类：Poincaré 源+度量熵 ⇒ oracle 不等式 ℓ*+n^{-2/(2+γ)}（强凸更快）；首次覆盖高斯源与 Barron/ICNN 网络 map，并证计算-统计鸿沟
tldr_en: Unified oracle inequalities for semi-dual OT map estimation over arbitrary potential classes under a Poincaré source and metric-entropy control; first rates for Gaussian sources and shallow-network maps, plus a CLWE-based hardness result.
key_numbers: Bounded case: E||∇φ̂−∇φ0||² ≲_log ℓ* + n^{-2/(2+γ)} ∨ n^{-1} (Thm 1, Eq. 15)
Recovers Hütter–Rigollet rate n^{-2(s−1)/(2s+d−4)} under Poincaré only (Thm 3, Eq. 35)
Barron space: n^{-(2s+k(1−2/d))/(2s+2k(1−2/d))} (Thm 4, Eq. 46); ReLU map upper n^{-1/2−1/(d−1)} vs lower n^{-1/2−5/(4d+2)} (Prop. 6)
Hardness: poly-time estimator at accuracy c'/√d for spiked class would solve CLWE/GapSVP (Thm 7); convex-hull PGD runs in O_J(n² log n) (Thm 6)
